title: DetailList
responsibility: Renders keyed semantic definition rows while callers provide labels, values and empty content.

inputs.name: DetailList.rows
inputs.description: Required rows in display order. Falsy values and repeated labels remain unmodified and are rendered by the caller snippets.

inputs.name: DetailList.rowKey
inputs.description: Required callback returning a stable unique string or numeric key for each row. Repeated labels must still have distinct keys.

inputs.name: DetailList.label
inputs.description: Required snippet receiving each row and rendering its definition term.

inputs.name: DetailList.children
inputs.description: Required snippet receiving each row and rendering its definition description.

inputs.name: DetailList.empty
inputs.description: Optional content shown instead of a definition list when rows is empty. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, showing No details to display. for empty rows.

inputs.name: DetailList.className
inputs.description: Optional feature classes, default an empty string.

inputs.name: DetailList.grouped
inputs.description: True by default to wrap each term/value pair in a row container. False emits flat dt/dd siblings for an existing definition-list layout.

inputs.name: DetailList.termTitle
inputs.description: Optional callback returning a term tooltip string or undefined. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, omitting title. Callback errors propagate.

inputs.name: DetailList.valueTitle
inputs.description: Optional callback returning a value tooltip string or undefined. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, omitting title. Callback errors propagate.

inputs.name: DetailList.valueClass
inputs.description: Optional callback returning the value element class string. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, omitting additional classes. Callback errors propagate.

outputs.name: DetailList
outputs.description: A definition list with one keyed term/description group per row, or caller-owned empty content. Empty rows without an empty snippet show No details to display.

errors.name: Caller content error
errors.description: Errors from supplied snippets, rowKey, termTitle, valueTitle or valueClass propagate; this component does not catch them.

errors.name: Duplicate row key
errors.description: Duplicate rowKey results are rejected during client updates; callers must provide distinct stable keys.
